The paper presents a platform that uses RAG (Pinecone retrieval with LLM generation) and reports pilot trials. The system also includes multimodal confidence assessment, but the RAG component itself is text-based, so E9 does not apply. It proposes a system with a RAG component and reports pilot results, which fits the include rule.
